Aider CUT à apprendre : à l’export, les: Help CUT learn: on export, the settings, three small images, the rhythm of the excerpt (not the sound itself) and the edit’s text go to CUT’s tree, seen by the founders only
À chaque export d’une vidéo, tant que la: On each export, as long as the “Help CUT learn” box is ticked (Publish step of CUT), ONIRIQUE CUT sends Onirique’s server: the settings of the edit (style, frame, transitions, fonts, colors and sizes of the text, effects); three small images of the video and their average colors; measurements of the excerpt (tempo, place in the song, length, energy, drop), never the sound itself; the names of the backgrounds used; the edit’s text (movie line, lyrics shown, description, title); the type of your account (founder or not). None of this is linked to your account or IP address, but the images and text may show or name people: untick the box for an edit that must not be used.
Ces éléments servent, sur la base de not: On the basis of our legitimate interest in improving CUT, these elements are used to evolve the settings it suggests and the AUTOMATIC tool (its “tree”, where every change is approved by a founder); only Onirique’s founders see them, and they are never published, sold or transferred. Images and text are kept for one year, settings and measurements for three years at most. The settings of the videos already kept in the CUT cloud, and the content of the founders’ ones, were taken in once the same way. You can object to this processing by unticking the box, and ask for a sending to be erased at support@onirique.store (with the title and date of the export).
Quand la case « Aider CUT à apprendre »: When the “Help CUT learn” box is ticked (it is by default and can be unticked at any time in CUT’s Publish step), each export sends Onirique the settings of the edit, three small images taken from the video, measurements of the excerpt (tempo, place in the song, energy, drop; never the sound itself), the names of the backgrounds used and the edit’s text (movie line, lyrics shown, description, title).
Pour ces seuls éléments, vous accordez à: For these elements only, you grant Onirique a free, non-exclusive licence limited to analysing them to improve ONIRIQUE CUT (its settings, the AUTOMATIC tool and its suggestions), for the retention period stated in the privacy policy. They are never published, sold, transferred or used for advertising: only Onirique’s founders see them. You remain the owner of your edits.
Vous garantissez avoir le droit d’utilis: You guarantee that you have the right to use what you put in your edits. If an edit must not be used for learning, untick the box before exporting it; to have an element already sent removed, write to support@onirique.store with the title and date of the export. Unticking the box changes nothing to how you use CUT.
ONIRIQUE CUT apprend aussi des montages: ONIRIQUE CUT also learns from exported edits, under the terms of article 19.
Pour aider les fondateurs à juger ce que: To help the founders judge what CUT learns, these elements (settings, measurements, text, and a few images of the latest edits) are reviewed, when a founder asks, by an artificial intelligence running on Onirique’s own server (Google’s Gemma model, run on site): nothing is sent to an outside service. It only writes an opinion for the founders; nothing is decided automatically about you.
Ces éléments peuvent être relus par une: These elements may be reviewed by an artificial intelligence running on Onirique’s own server that helps the founders judge what CUT learns; nothing is sent to an outside service, and it decides nothing.
